benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families consisting of husband, wife and minor children with cultivable land in their names, subject to official exclusion criteria and government verification
required_documents: Aadhaar details, Aadhaar-linked bank account and land ownership records; additional requirements may apply
application_process: Register through the official PM-KISAN portal or an authorised Common Service Centre (CSC). Complete mandatory e-KYC. State authorities verify land and beneficiary records.
latest_updates: 24th instalment released on 30 October 2026, reaching over 9.34 crore farmers with more than ₹18,690 crore. Continuation approved for 2026-27 to 2030-31 with an outlay of ₹3.15 lakh crore. e-KYC is mandatory. Certain suspected exclusion cases may have benefits temporarily withheld pending physical verification.
status_as_of: Active; subject to eligibility and verification

target_beneficiary: Farmers including landowners tenant farmers and sharecroppers growing notified crops in notified areas with insurable interest
benefits: Crop insurance against specified natural risks including drought floods storms hailstorms pests and diseases. Farmer premium is capped at 2% for Kharif foodgrain and oilseed crops 1.5% for Rabi foodgrain and oilseed crops and 5% for annual commercial and horticultural crops.
eligibility_criteria: The farmer must have an insurable interest in a notified crop grown in a notified area. Tenant farmers and sharecroppers may qualify subject to valid land records tenure agreements or other documents permitted by the State Government. Crop and season notification conditions apply.
required_documents: Land ownership or possession records or valid tenancy or sharecropping documents as applicable; bank account details and other documents required by the State Government or implementing agency.
application_process: Apply through the official PMFBY portal an authorised Common Service Centre or the designated bank or insurance channel within the notified season deadline. Check crop and area notification before applying.
latest_updates: For 2026-27 the Union Budget allocation reported by PIB is ₹12,200 crore. PIB reported that 25 States and Union Territories were implementing PMFBY in Kharif 2026. Enrolment deadlines and notified crops vary by State area and season. Farmers can use the official portal and helpline 14447.
status_as_of: Active; crop and area notifications vary by State and season

scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
target_beneficiary: Meritorious students pursuing regular college or university degree courses after Class 12
benefits: ₹12,000 per year for the first three years of graduation; ₹20,000 per year at postgraduate level. Technical degree students may receive ₹20,000 in the fourth year.
eligibility_criteria: Must be above the 80th percentile in the relevant Class 12 board stream; pursuing a regular degree course; family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per year; must not receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement; students who took a gap year after Class 12 are not eligible for fresh applications.
required_documents: Class 12 marksheet; family income certificate; caste certificate for reserved-category applicants; disability certificate if applicable.
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal using OTR. Select the scheme, complete academic and personal details, upload required documents and submit. The institute and State Nodal Agency must verify the application.
latest_updates: For academic year 2026-27, NSP lists fresh student applications open until 30 November 2026. Renewal conditions and deadlines may differ. Verify the live portal before advising applicants.
